reply:
Spacing works because each review comes just as you're **about to forget**, so pulling the memory back takes effort, and that effort is what makes it stick [1]. Cramming feels easier, which is exactly why it fades faster [2].

Want me to quiz you on it?

citations.title: How spaced repetition works
citations.heading: Why spacing works
citations.text: Each retrieval at the edge of forgetting strengthens the memory more than an easy one.

citations.title: Make It Stick
citations.heading: Massed practice
citations.text: Massed practice feels productive, but the gains fade quickly.
